people.name: Chuza
people.line: Herod's steward, whose wife Joanna supported Jesus

people.name: Herod
people.line: Tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry.

people.name: Joanna
people.line: A follower of Jesus who supported His ministry

people.name: Susanna
people.line: Woman who helped support Jesus and his disciples

translations.web: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others; who served them from their possessions.
translations.bsb: Joanna the wife of Herod’s household manager Chuza, Susanna, and many others. These women were ministering to them out of their own means.
translations.kjv: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
translations.asv: and Joanna the wife of Chuzas Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, who ministered unto them of their substance.
